definition_record.replay_mapping: Adaptation to original indexed-survivor agreement: every surviving site must match its original indexed target. Interior erasures select a target subsequence, not CodeIP's original contiguous prefix. Zero survivors satisfy the adapted rule vacuously. Historical available_prefix keys remain for compatibility; these scores are not literal CodeIP prefix scores.
